prompt: Write a story about a guy who’s famous in his neighborhood for going out after storms to help with downed trees and shovel sidewalks, but one night he decides to fix a popped-off manhole cover and ends up in serious trouble. Start your story with him standing in the pouring rain, trying to force the heavy lid back onto the hole. Finish with a tense hospital scene showing how his family and community deal with his injuries and what it taught them about his kindness. Include detailed storm descriptions, moments of suspense, and a reflection on the fine line between heroism and recklessness, aiming for about 8,000 to 10,000 words.
